validated_objective: Produce a QIF v0.3 Discovery Layer design that helps non-experts discover candidate Quality Intents without introducing checklist-driven quality definition.
scope: Define Discovery Layer boundary relative to QIF representation layer.
Define Discovery Pattern entity and canonical pattern taxonomy candidates.
Define dynamic discovery flow from stakeholder/source intake to candidate Quality Intent generation.
Define evidence traceability, confidence, uncertainty, and discovery coverage without checklist completion metrics.
Define acceptance criteria and implementation recommendations for a later v0.3 schema/runtime slice.
constraints: Do not merge Discovery Layer into QIF core representation semantics.
Do not introduce fixed quality checklists or mandatory quality category coverage.
Do not build UI or external integrations in this slice.
Do not specialize the model to software development only.
Do not claim AI-discovered Quality Intents are semantically true without review and governance.
expected_outcomes: A design document suitable for Claude Code, Codex, or human implementers.
AOF council judgment from Visionary, Builder, and Guardian.
Clear recommendation for what v0.3 should build and what it should defer.
